notes.title: Patch 0.3 preview and what I´m working on
notes.content:
Hello Dungeon Clicker!

Things have changed a lot since the game was released in August. Thanks to all the feedback received during these months, the game has been changing and I have tried to introduce all the improvements that you liked the most or those you have requested from the beginning, and thanks to all of that, I can say that the game is much better now, so thank you all for that wonderful feedback. ːsteamhappyː

If any of you are impatient for the next 0.3 patch, here are some things I'm working on right now.
[list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/274fdade1673f307481ba7e5c3a38966c02ed68a.png[/img]
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Raids[/b]
Raids are single wave dungeons where you will find a powerful boss.  Once you kill the boss, the Raid will be completed. Simple, isn't it?.
Entering the raid has clear advantages: Time and resources. Entering costs both keys and scrolls, but the loot is higher and also takes less time. You have 99 seconds to kill a Raid boss. This boss will have high health or shields, but will also drop much higher loot. But you will have to be careful because Raid bosses have high damage.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/ac29c7a64bd64a4e43f2a021aef6f9a01c6c86a8.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]New UI Interface[/b]
The old warmap interface was small, and did not clearly provide all the information about dungeons. Also, making additions was somewhat more difficult. With the new interface, there is more information, and it has more readability. Of course, everything is subject to change and what you see in the image may not correspond to the final appearance of the interface.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/bb0c64b4b28f75edcd2d9bb40afb6252b86abc39.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Perks[/b]
Perks are unlockable benefits that can be dropped by both bosses and any enemy, depending on the description.
Each perk has a different ability and once an enemy has dropped you, the perk will be unlocked immediately and the character will have that advantage activated.

Each character has 6 perks to unlock and a last one that is an active ability, in total there are 7 per character. That adds up to a total of 28 new unlockable skills.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/ec72813776bab7e4205986e300459d009fa67bd6.jpg[/img]
[list]
Take for example "Shock Bullets". It is a perk that when activated converts the normal Gunner´s bullets into lightning bullets, leaving the enemy whit a 100% damage per second debuff. It seems powerful right? You just have to read a few of them to see how powerful they can be. This is just one example of the Gunner's perks. Each character will have many, many more.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]New Bosses[/b]
Dungeon Clicker will have many bosses, when the daily quest arrive in a future patch, you will be tasked with killing a boss. Well then we need more variety of bosses.
I have introduced 3 new bosses, each with different behavior and attacks to make them more challenging. Here you can see Skadi in action. Be careful, it does a lot of damage.

Also, some other bosses in the game such as Mimic and Lord of The Keys now have different behavior than idle and will attack characters.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/d2cf48212e915d5617398ea85dad616e0afa4e57.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Backup and auto recovery save[/b]
The old save system had some drawbacks, so performance has been improved and also the game will always make a backup of your old save and detect if the current save file is corrupt and automatically replace it with the backup copy.
[/list]

Many more things are coming in the 0.3 patch, stay tunned and thank you for all your support!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.12b
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an error where enemies inside Golden Dungeon had a multiplier HP.
[*]Fixed an error with some textures inside Golden Dungeon.
[*]Fixed an error where offline gold window could appear during game.
[*]Increased offline gold by 1200%.
[*]Increased gold earned by killing bosses in normal waves. Now every passed stage adds a x2 multiplier.
[*]Increased gold earned in Dungeons x100. 
[*]Bosses in Dungeons have now a x50 multiplier dropping gold.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.12
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Golden Chamber has been added to the game. Now players can access to this Dungeon from the WarMap. This Dungeon is incremental, that means enemies inside Golden Dungeon will have a similar HP (10 waves below) depending of the current wave in the Adventure. Gold is also incremental and has a multiplier x5 in normal waves and x50 in boss waves, and it also depends on the current wave. Entering this dungeon is worth, but also cost 50 keys.
[*]Reset talents has been added to the game. Players can now reset talents if they have enough gold. Reseting talents has no effect on pet talents, pet selection or ascension passive skills. If players have pet skill unlocked this skill won´t be reset.
[*]Auto Farming has been added to the game. Now from Warmap, players can decide if the game enters automatically in the same dungeon until all keys have been wasted. Players can cancel autofarming when clicking "Return to Map" button.
[*]WarMap button has been added.
[/list]

[b]TECHNICAL[/b]
[list]
[*]Save time has been optimized.
[*]Added damage numbers toggle. Now damage done to enemies can be hidden from Options menu.  Hiding damage numbers can cause a performance boost in low specs computers.
[*]Coins particles has been optimized.
[/list]

[b]BUG[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an error where points to spend didn't match in Archer talents.
[*]Fixed an error where DPS info didn´t show correctly in the characters window. Now all characters show base damage correctly. Base damage and DPS will not include the extra damage done in only certain situations, like damage done to bosses or armored enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug where Wizard could make critical hits every time.
[*]Fixed a bug where Fire Twister could make reduced damage.
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]Gold dropped by bosses in normal waves has been increased by 100%.
[*]Base offline gold  has been incremented from 1.55 to 5.
[/list]

[b]CHARACTERS[/b] 
[i]Archer[/i]
[list]
[*]Death from above has now 80% increased damage.
[*]Conflagrate has now 100% increased damage.
[*]Volley makes 100% of the base damage.
[/list]
[i]Wizard[/i]
[list]
[*]Fire Twister speed has been increased to reach distant enemies.
[*]Fireball fx has been changed and improved.
[*]Fireball speed has been changed from 100 to 120 to reach targets faster.
[/list]

notes.title: The main idea, philosophy and development.
notes.content:
Hi Dungeon Clickers!

In this first post about the game, I wanted to give you a small sample of what the game really is, what it consists of, its philosophy and what's the actual state of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/472eb9f8fe057a385bc4e59dbee9fdbb9336e9bf.png[/img]

The main idea before the game went into development, was to make a clicker, not only in which you had a feeling of progression, but also was fun. That´s why the main mechanic of Dungeons Clicker is the combat and the feeling that you are fighting something else and not  just numbers. But there are tons of numbers, believe me.

In this respect, to this day, I think that the combat system, regardless of whether it is a clicker or not, is fun. The role-playing component that I have added, with talents, passive skills and active skills, gives it a fresh and new air, however, it requires a lot of balancing. 
Currently there are 4 characters who have skills and talents, each with a damage that can be increased not only by leveling up, but through those skills. They have critical chance, critical damage, damage over time, life, life regeneration, attack speed, etc ..., and all this is calculated automatically and through formulas that require a lot,  lot of balancing, not to mention the enemies.
On the other hand and speaking about the combat,  at a very early stage, the enemies did not attack to heroes and neither did the bosses. Killing enemies was cool, but there was little tension in each wave, which were pretty much static, like most clickers.

The enemy combat system is much more polished now. The enemies will attack the heroes, and if there are none left alive, they will attack your chest, stealing gold with each hit. So in high waves, you have to be careful!
Bosses on the other hand had to appear challenging, but at the same time not forget that it is still a clicker and that only one click can kill it. However, each boss will have their own ability, like summoning more enemies, throwing poison balls, fire breath and a long etcetera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/b741b072511ef50cdac62ab54582286b0edafd4f.png[/img]

When I started the development of the game, there were several questions that needed to be answered such as :

[list]
[*][b]Does the game have an ending?[/b]
Yes, the game has an ending. The philosophy of the game is Dungeon Clicker is a game, and it must have it. That is why at this point, several things were taken into account.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]The game will have an ending, with an epic final fight.[/b] 
There is no point in extending the game indefinitely if there is no reason. Normally that reason is usually economic in these types of games, which ruins the gaming experience and also brings us to the next point.
[/list]
 [list]
[*] [b]Will you have an online store or something similar? [/b]
No. If the game had a store implies a completely different model and would affect the gameplay. In this sense,  Dungeon Clicker is designed to be finished without the need for a store, which is why the model is premium instead of Free to Play.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]So you never have to start from 0?[/b]
No. There is no need to start from scratch to get more resources or better resources. To simplify that  and avoid losing progress there are a series of dungeons in which you can farm the resources you need without having to go back to wave 1, which was pointless. Although, to enter those dungeons you need another type of resource.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Does the game have a system similar to ascension?[/b]
Yes. Once the endgame is reached, you will need the resources to improve your ascension skills, without the need to travel through time or return to the starting square.
[/list]

I know there are much more questions to be solved.  This is a very summarized sample of the philosophy of the game, which I will gradually explain more in depth, along with other aspects of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/b8b11394ca41596b6a784fa047bb71ce375c7efa.png[/img]

Dungeon Clicker progresses as expected. The development is not having major delays apart from uncontrollable situations due to Covid19 and that it is being developed by a single person. Regardless of that, the game is in a very early stage, although the core of the game is 100% finished and right now I am very focused on environment design and AI programming of some bosses and enemies.

The user interface is practically finished but there are some aspects that need to be polished. The Dungeons selection system, what comes to be called the War Map, is almost finished for early access release, although pretty much everything you'll see in the alpha is subject to change.

Much remains to be done, many placeholders have to be changed, such as icons, sounds, particles, textures, enemies ... so that the game, as you can see in the trailer, has improved substantially, since every day I make changes so much in UI as in game and engine.

I hope that simply with this post I have clarified some doubts about how the game is progressing. In the next post we will talk about the enemies and the environments, until then, I hope you liked the first development update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296271/3f9176756a3396222ce773df588555adb113753e.png[/img]

Greetings Dungeon Clickers!
